verdict.rationale: Ramp documents Funds whose restrictions cover amount, interval, allowed merchant categories and allowed merchants, and its marketing says it can enforce spend limits and block risky merchants or categories before spend happens. That covers the restriction half of the story, with blocking at purchase time implied. However, automatic card locking on policy violation is not documented (the only lock evidence is a manual CLI or MCP 'lock' action), and authorization-time declines are stated only in a marketing line. missing for 10: documented auto-lock of cards on out-of-policy spend, technical documentation of point-of-sale authorization declines, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can restrict cards by category, merchant, and amount — and the platform auto-locks or declines out-of-policy spend at the point of sale

citations.quote: Funds. A budget with restrictions — amount, interval (daily, monthly, total), allowed merchant categories, allowed merchants, allowed countries.
Set submission requirements, enforce spend limits, and block risky merchants or categories all before spend happens.
Issue cards, attach controls, and watch spend in real time
